(Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from a group of materials including a thermally conductive epoxy; and a solvent, wherein the composition excludes any use of glue as a binder.

(Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface, and the composition is applied without a separate adhesive substance.

(Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface and the solvent is specifically selected from the group consisting of ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, and FC-87.
